patch_description: Replace the single shared RZ parameter with two independent RZ parameters: one applied before the CZ chain (rz_pre) and one after (rz_post). This allows independent control over phases inserted immediately before and after entanglement, enabling finer interference tuning without increasing parameter count or depth. The circuit structure remains [RX]→[RZ_pre]→[CZ-chain]→[RZ_post], but with two parameter degrees of freedom instead of one, which should improve convergence speed and potentially reduce the training gap by better utilizing the available phase landscape around the critical entanglement layer.
